Hi Elena / Karthik,

Thanks — I pulled the UEN and matched it against our billing entity lookup. The certificate looks valid but the invoice line currently maps to the Marketplace tax code in our billing system, which triggers a manual GST proof check in APAC. Two options to unblock quickly: 

1) Fast-track clearance: Elena, if you can reply with a signed attestation (PDF) that confirms NovaWorks is the billed customer (UEN 202612345D) and that the supplied services are B2B SaaS (non-supplied goods) we can mark this invoice as cleared today and release for payment. See template: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/novaworks/gst-evidence/attestation-template.docx

2) Self-bill enrollment: If NovaWorks signs our self-billing addendum we can switch to auto-accept of GST proof for subsequent invoices (reduces manual reviews). That process requires: signed addendum, copy of UEN, and a short legal attestation on letterhead. Once uploaded we put the account into the "collection-cue: auto-accept" queue (weekly batch run).

I set the current invoice to "pending proof" and attached the internal checklist. If you send the attestation, I will run the batch unlock (usually takes ~2 business hours).

Ben — looping you for PO/contract match and for any billing-side adjustments we should make to prevent future marketplace misclassification.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Collections Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: [internal-checklist-GST-APAC.pdf]
